PRODUCT CATEGORY

Natural Products

The Natural Products group includes the natural dish sponge with a natural-fibre-look surface, as well as dish, bath and make-up removal sponges made from cellulose sponge.

The natural dish sponge comes in paper-band packaging; the cellulose sponges come in various shapes such as oval, wave, star and flower.
